bindings.caption: Construct faceted core and shell geometry. Initial core diameter: 1.2 nm; Computational starting CdSe-core diameter, not a measured colloid size. Bond removal threshold: 2 bonds; Atoms with fewer than two bonds are removed, not atoms with exactly two bonds. Environment: Not reported; Atmosphere not reported for this operation. Faceted CdSe cores; add CdSe, CdS or ZnS monolayers using lattice-preserving chalcogenide/metal translations, removing atoms with fewer than2bonds and preserving facets. Computational data-flow diagram only; no atomic coordinates or calculated outputs are invented. Authored conceptual stage illustration; not measured apparatus or particle structure.

bindings.caption: Construct dimers and trimers. Environment: Not reported; Atmosphere not reported for this operation. Start two CdSe cores separated by an integer lattice translation. Add CdS/ZnS to set size and neck thickness. Restrict added layers to interface for area variation at fixed dot spacing/asymmetric trimers. For spacing variation at fixed neck thickness, split a fused dimer halfway along its bond, add lattice translations and duplicate interface atoms into the gap. Manually check intended structural parameters. Computational data-flow diagram only; no atomic coordinates or calculated outputs are invented. Authored conceptual stage illustration; not measured apparatus or particle structure.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
